import json, subprocess, sys, time, traceback
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/work')
import gen as G
import check as C

def main():
    n = int(sys.argv[1]); seed0 = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 0
    prog = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv)>3 else '/app/submission/planner.py'
    reqs = [G.gen(seed0+i) for i in range(n)]
    data = "".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in reqs).encode()
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, prog], input=data, capture_output=True)
    dt=time.time()-t0
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print("PLANNER CRASH", p.returncode); print(p.stderr.decode()[-4000:]); return 1
    lines = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
    if len(lines) != n:
        print("LINE COUNT MISMATCH", len(lines), n); 
    nbad=0
    for i, r in enumerate(reqs):
        if i >= len(lines): break
        try:
            resp = json.loads(lines[i])
        except Exception as e:
            print(i, "UNPARSEABLE", lines[i][:200]); nbad+=1; continue
        L = C.build(r)
        try:
            st, val = C.check_response(r, resp, L)
        except Exception as e:
            nbad += 1
            print("FAIL", i, repr(e))
            try:
                rst, rval = C.reference_optimum(L)
                print("   reference:", rst, rval, "claimed:", resp.get("status"), resp.get("mlu"))
            except Exception as e2:
                print("   reference failed:", repr(e2))
            if nbad <= 3:
                print("   resp:", json.dumps(resp)[:600])
                print("   req :", json.dumps(r)[:600])
        # else ok
    print("checked %d, bad %d, time %.2fs" % (min(n,len(lines)), nbad, dt))
    return 1 if nbad else 0

sys.exit(main())
PYEOF
